title: Cortical-neuron cfDNA fraction in AD blood — Loyfer/Moss array atlas
card: ad-immune-epic v2.1 → v2.2 pending VAL-091 outcome
method: NNLS deconvolution against nloyfer/meth_atlas reference_atlas.csv (Loyfer 2023 Nature 613:355). Cortical_neurons row extracted per cohort.
interpretation_note: O4_AD_NEURO_NULL is the AD card v2.1 PREDICTION. The card explicitly states "Stage 2 Moss NNLS for AD is expected NULL — brain tissue not in buffy coat." VAL-091 tests this prediction with the Loyfer atlas (which has a Cortical_neurons reference Moss 2018 lacked). O4 confirms the prediction; O1-O3 contradict it; O5 is biologically anomalous.
primary_outcome_basis: Within-cohort AIBL AD-vs-HC d = -0.026 [-0.21, +0.17] is the strongest single-cohort evidence (largest n, panel-training cohort, EPIC platform). Within-cohort AddNeuroMed AD-vs-HC d = -0.083 [-0.36, +0.19] confirms across platform. The pooled-AD-vs-external-HC d = +1.075 reported in the analysis output is NOT a valid primary statistic because the cross-cohort HC baseline fold range is 28.7× — pooling AD samples whose underlying HC baselines differ by 28-fold confounds disease effect with cohort/platform/preprocessing batch.

caveats.addneuromed_baseline_shift: AddNeuroMed HC mean cortical-neuron fraction is 7.4%, vs ~0.3% in AIBL HC and GIFT HC. AddNeuroMed is 450K with only 5599 of 6105 Loyfer reference CpGs present (8% missing). NNLS with reduced reference coverage routes mass into Cortical_neurons by default when discriminating CpGs are absent. The within-AddNeuroMed AD-vs-HC contrast is still valid (both arms suffer the same routing) but absolute fractions are not interpretable.
caveats.gift_n15_outlier: GIFT n=15 AD shows d=+0.96 in raw boxplot, but the median AD = 0.9% vs median HC = 0.0% is modest. The mean is pulled by a single 5.8% outlier (GSM1300378). With n=15 and one outlier driving the effect, this signal is not robust enough to claim against the AIBL/AddNeuroMed null. GIFT also has its own well-documented batch offset (per VAL-057, GSE53740 HC sit elevated vs 80-cell baseline by 2.3 SD).
caveats.gift_specificity_arm: FTD d=+0.19 (essentially null), PSP/CBD d=-0.51 (PSP/CBD reads LOWER cortical-neuron than HC). No tauopathy-class elevation. The signal pattern argues against either tauopathy-shared or generic-neurodegeneration explanations.

card_v21_prediction: Card v2.1 README states: "Stage 2 Moss NNLS for AD is expected NULL — brain tissue is not in buffy coat at levels Moss NNLS can resolve." VAL-091 tested this prediction with the expanded Loyfer atlas (which DOES include a Cortical_neurons sorted-cell reference Moss 2018 lacked). The within-cohort AIBL and AddNeuroMed nulls confirm the prediction extends to the Loyfer-augmented Stage 2 readout.
edear_routing_implication: Glioma plasma cortical-neuron fraction (VAL-090): ~1.09% (4× HC). AIBL AD plasma cortical-neuron fraction: ~0.25% (HC-equivalent). Cortical-neuron cfDNA fraction is a cross-platform discriminator between glioma and AD at the cohort level. EDEAR Stage 2 cortical-neuron tile becomes a glioma-vs-AD differentiator when both Stage 1 panels (AD-directional immune for AD, immune A-score for glioma) co-flag.
